Answer: E
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple small, well-defined nodular opacities predominantly in the upper and mid-lung zones with a reticulo-nodular pattern, which is characteristic of silicosis. This radiographic distribution distinguishes it from sarcoidosis (typically associated with bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy) and pulmonary fibrosis (which typically shows lower zone honeycombing).
